name: ActionReasoningBench
description: A diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on Reasoning about Actions and Change (RAC) across six key dimensions including Fluent Tracking, State Tracking, Action Executability, Effects of Actions, Numerical RAC, and Composite Questions. It includes 8 domains and questions involving up to 19 action sequences, with new ramification constraints to capture indirect effects of actions.
reputation: A recent diagnostic benchmark for action and change reasoning that is mainly used in research papers on commonsense and temporal reasoning, with limited broad adoption so far.
notes: Includes new ramification constraints to capture indirect effects of actions; evaluates multiple RAC dimensions with varying difficulty.
